call_points.text: FY27 capex guided at ₹700-800 Cr, with ₹180 Cr already spent in Q1FY27.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated the range; memory's watchlist tracks FY27 capex

call_points.text: Fuel additives capacity expanded to 360 KTPA from 290 KTPA; high utilisation expected this quarter.
Augene JV commissioning in Q2FY27; guided steady-state revenue of ₹300-400 Cr, consolidating at PAT level.
Aarti Circularity plastic recycling is slated for commissioning in the second half of FY27.
West Asia's revenue share fell from about 15% to 2% as the conflict halted energy exports.
Overall volumes fell 12% QoQ, with energy down 17% and non-energy down 7%.
FX and inventory gains were estimated at ₹50-60 Cr, which management said are hard to quantify.
Gasoline-naphtha cracks averaged $15-18 per barrel, supporting fuel additives demand.
Working capital expanded on higher feedstock prices and export volumes, raising debt and finance costs.
Management declined to quantify the US MMA addressable market, citing early market development.

penalties.authority: State Tax Officer-3, Office of the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Enforcement, Div.-8, Surat, Gujarat.
penalties.details: A Demand Order in Form GST DRC-07 has been passed under Section 74 of the GGST Act, 2017 read with the CGST Act, 2017. The order raises a demand to recover inadmissible Input Tax Credit (ITC) along with applicable interest and penalties. Company is in the process of filing the appeal to the First appelleate level.
penalties.impact: There is a total quantifiable financial impact of Rs. 29,17,288 due to the demand order. This total amount consists of: Tax Liability: Rs. 9,35,636 , Interest: Rs. 10,46,016 Penalty: Rs. 9,35,636. The above Penalty is not breaching the materiality thresholds as per Regulation 30.

operating_notes.text: MMA capacity increased from 200 to 290 kTPA, with further expansion to 360 kTPA underway.
Middle East markets account for roughly 9% to 10% of annual revenue, primarily in energy applications.
West Asia's share of revenue fell from about 15% to 2% in Q1FY27 as the conflict halted energy exports.
Fuel additives capacity expanded to 360 KTPA from 290 KTPA; high utilisation expected in Q2FY27.
Gasoline-naphtha cracks averaged $15-18 per barrel in Q1FY27.
Entered into a 10+ year dedicated manufacturing and supply agreement with a revenue potential of ₹1,500 crore.

timeline.summary: Aarti Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,422 crore (+9% YoY) and PAT of ₹137 crore (+43% YoY), while flagging near-term supply chain headwinds from West Asia.
Aarti Industries' Q1FY27 call (July 31, 2026) reported revenue of ₹2,627 Cr (+41% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹385 Cr (+79%), with West Asia revenue share falling to 2% and Zone IV delayed 3-6 months.
Aarti Industries secured a 10+ year manufacturing and supply agreement worth ₹1,500 crore with a global specialty chemical company.
Aarti Industries entered into a 10+ year specialty chemical supply agreement worth ₹1,500 crore on October 13, 2026.
